milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.summary: The core protocol: stealth address cryptography, smart contracts, AI agent, and TEE deployment.
highlights: Cryptographic primitives across EVM, Stellar, Solana, and CKB
ERC-5564 / ERC-6538 standards with atomic send-and-announce
Gas-sponsored withdrawals via EIP-7702 and human-readable .wraith names
AI agent system deployed to a Phala (Intel TDX) TEE

milestones.title: Unified Platform
milestones.summary: Every chain consolidated into a single SDK with a unified Spectre TEE server.
highlights: Unified Spectre TEE server with a ChainConnector interface
Smart contracts across EVM, Stellar, Solana, and CKB
Multichain demo app and developer documentation

milestones.title: Platform Launch
milestones.summary: A public developer API with managed infrastructure and consumer-facing products.
highlights: Managed API with developer keys and rate limiting
Developer console for analytics and billing
Mainnet contract deployments and a mobile consumer wallet
Expanded EVM chains: Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism

milestones.title: Chain Expansion
milestones.summary: New chain families and on-chain private messaging.
highlights: Support for Hedera, Starknet, Sui, Aptos, and TON
On-chain private messaging via ECDH encryption
ERC-4337 Paymaster support as an alternative to EIP-7702

milestones.title: Research
milestones.summary: FHE-DKSAP: Fully Homomorphic Encryption-based Dual-Key Stealth Address Protocol.
highlights: Trustless outsourced scanning without exposing viewing keys
